x-e-m2-01.s.s2.r.a: Hunda azo so adîko tâ ayeke sara sika so ayeke na ndali.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.o.b: Ndoye gi nömörö na ligne 3 ti ayeke kete ahon 18, ti ligne use alingbi na tele ti ala.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.r.b: Atâa tongana nömörö use alingbi na tele ti ala, tongana ala ayeke valeur so a dîko tâ pëpe, tënë ti sioni angbâ.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.o.c: Gbu gi "mingi" na place ti nömörö, ti kpa chance ti ayeke sioni.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.r.c: Erreur akpa, me tënë na texte akpa nga na ni.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.explain: Post gi alingbi ti fa pëpe nömörö wa na yâ ti use ayeke tâ. Bâ na azo so adîko nömörö ti kozo na sara sika ni na tâ ayeke lege so ayeke na preuve. Ndoye ni na 'mingi' nga akpa erreur, me ni akpa tënë.

x-e-m2-03.title: Wara emploi du temps so alingbi na condition na email ti réunion ti club
x-e-m2-03.goal: Hunda condition kue na email, sara emploi du temps ti nde so asara ala, na fa condition wa mo bâ.
x-e-m2-03.material:
Ni ayeke email ti Hana, président ti club ti lecture, na membre oko, Minho. Gbu lâ tongana nömörö: Mon=1, Tue=2, Wed=3, Thu=4, Fri=5.

Hi Minho,
Let's plan our reading club meeting for next week.
1) We meet on a weekday, Monday to Friday, but not on Wednesday (I have a dentist visit) and not on Friday (the library closes early).
2) School ends at 3 p.m., so we can start at 3 p.m. at the earliest. The room can be used until 6 p.m.
3) The meeting takes two hours, and it always starts on the hour.
Please send me the days and start times that work.
Thanks, Hana

x-e-m2-06.s.s1.prompt: Sï ligne so ton tî ni alingbi mingi ape tî sara na zo so awara ni (maître).
x-e-m2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Sara comparaison tî ton tî phrase so ademander ye na salutation na phrases tî ndali.
x-e-m2-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sû so ligne ôko ôko ayeke salutation, présentation, demande, ndali, wala merci, na lire ni na voix haute tongana mo tene na maître.
x-e-m2-06.s.s1.explain: Ligne 3 ayeke na ton tî ordre ('Give me ... now.'), ndali ni ni abâ rude tongana demande na maître. Ligne 1 ayeke salutation, ligne 2 ayeke présentation tî mo même, ligne 4 ayeke ndali, na ligne 5 ayeke merci, ndali ni ala kûê alingbi.
x-e-m2-06.s.s2.prompt: Sï phrase so alingbi mingi tî remplacer ligne 3.
x-e-m2-06.s.s2.hint.0: Sara comparaison tî formes: ni ayeke ordre, wala question so ademander permission?
x-e-m2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Zia choix ôko ôko na yâ tî e-mail tî maître, lire ni na voix haute, na sû ndali wa ni abâ bizarre.
x-e-m2-06.s.s2.r.a: "Hey" na ton décontracté alingbi na ami.
x-e-m2-06.s.s2.r.b: Ni ayeke na 'please', me ni angbâ ordre na ni asara so a ye tî mä gbâ.
x-e-m2-06.s.s2.r.c: Ni ayeke demande poli so ademander so mo lingbi tî emprunter ni wala pëpe.
x-e-m2-06.s.s2.r.d: Ni abâ tongana demande so ademander permission, na ni atene kozo so lo bezoin ni na pekoni ademander accord ape.
x-e-m2-06.s.s2.explain: Could I borrow ... , please? ayeke poli ndali zo so ademander ayeke gi permission tî zo nde. "Please give me ... now" ayeke ordre atâa na please, "Hey, can you ..." ayeke ton décontracté so alingbi na ami, na "I need ..." abâ tongana exigence ndali ni atene kozo ye so mo bezoin.
x-e-m2-06.s.s3.prompt: Réécrire ligne 3 na politesse na maître na anglais, na lege tî mo même, nde na choix so na ndö.
x-e-m2-06.s.s3.hint.0: Essayer tî commencer na question so ademander permission (Could/May/Would ...) wala na 'I would like ...'.
x-e-m2-06.s.s3.hint.1: Vérifier so phrase tî mo atene so mo aye tî emprunter clé.

x-e-m2-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ye so mo ademander (clé) ayeke clair?
x-e-m2-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Mo kpe tî sû mingi na tourner autour?
x-e-m2-06.s.s3.modelNote.3: Can you ...? ayeke décontracté kêtê ahon Could ...? me ni ayeke question so ademander permission.

x-e-m2-07.thinking.1: Sû so émotion asi gï na indices

x-e-m2-07.s.s1.explain: b amû lege na lecteur tî devine nervosité na action tî keep rereading the notes na situation so test ayeke tongana gï. a ayeke na mot tî émotion direct (scared), na c ayeke na indice tî devine test wala nervosité ape.

x-e-m2-08.title: Décider ye so a demander avant tî sï restaurant tî dîner d'anniversaire

x-e-m2-08.material:
Mbeni ami ademander mo: "Recommend a restaurant near Hongik University Station where 8 people can eat Korean food on Saturday at 7 p.m."

Publicité tî restaurant so mo wara:
Seoul Table — Korean food. Main dishes 12,000 to 16,000 won. Open every day, 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. Near Hongdae Station. Our tables seat up to 6 people.

x-e-m2-08.s.s1.prompt: Question wa mo lingbi tî demander na restaurant avant tî recommander ni?

x-e-m2-08.s.s1.r.b: Ni ayeke condition so ami ademander ape. Ni ayeke essentiel ape tî décision tî recommandation.
x-e-m2-08.s.s1.r.c: Publicité atene awe "every day from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m."
x-e-m2-08.s.s1.r.d: Ni ayeke question na ndö tî ndambo so "up to 6 people" tî publicité na condition tî ami (azo 8) aconflict.
x-e-m2-08.s.s1.explain: Publicité atene so table ôko ôko asi azo 6 tî ngbâ, me ami ayeke na azo 8. Ndambo so alingbi tî a résoudre ni avant tî mo recommander ni. Ayeke vuko na gare na ouvert na ndurû tî Saturday ayeke na yâ tî publicité awe, na menu végétarien ayeke condition so ami ademander ape.
x-e-m2-08.s.s2.prompt: Sû message anglais tî sara na restaurant. Tene na ala nömörö tî azo, lâ, na temps, na mû ôko question so aréso problème so mo gi na ndö.

x-e-m2-09.title: Sû demande tî changer lâ tî pratique nde nde na maître na na ami
x-e-m2-09.goal: Sû même contenu na ton na forme nde nde na gbe tî zo so awara ni, na jugement so parties wa alingbi tî changer.
x-e-m2-09.material:
Pratique tî présentation tî club ayeke programmée na Wednesday. Me test tî école ayeke na lâ so, ndali ni mbeni élève aye tî changer pratique na Thursday. Élève apensée tî sara message na brouillon so na gbe tongana ni ayeke.

'Wednesday is bad. Change it to Thursday. I have a test.'

Lo yeke sara demande so (1) na maître tî club Mr. Han na (2) na ami tî même club.

x-e-m2-09.thinking.1: Sara séparation tî ye so alingbi tî changer na ye so a zia ni tongana ni ayeke
x-e-m2-09.prereq.0: Expressions tî suggestion tongana Can we ...? / Could we ...?
x-e-m2-09.prereq.1: Anzo tî ndo ngangu tongana lâ tî semaine na test
x-e-m2-09.s.s1.prompt: Yôro ndo kue ti brouillon so a lingbi ti kiri sara ni tongana a zia ni na professeur.
x-e-m2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Bâ phrase oko oko ti brouillon abâ tongana nyen na professeur.
x-e-m2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Fa ndulu ti information so professeur a besoin ni ti zia décision (ndali, lâ vandâ) na ton (forme ti phrase).

x-e-m2-09.s.s1.r.a: Tongana mo kpe ndali, ni afa pëpe ndali so e aye ti kiri ni, ni la ni abâ tongana exigence ti côté oko gï.

x-e-m2-09.s.s1.r.b: Ni ayeke ndo ti kozo so afa politesse na zo so awara ni.
x-e-m2-09.s.s1.o.c: Kiri sara "Change it to Thursday." na question so ahunda permission (na exemple, Could we ...?).
x-e-m2-09.s.s1.r.c: Ni ayeke direction ti kiri sara ni na forme ti ti hunda, si zo ti ambeni alingbi ti zia décision.
x-e-m2-09.s.s1.o.d: Sara changement ti "bad" gï na "not good for me" na ngbâ na forme ti phrase ti nzoroko tongana ni ayeke.
x-e-m2-09.s.s1.r.d: Même tongana mo kete mot oko, tongana forme ti ordre tongana "Change it to Thursday." angbâ, ni abâ ti ngbele ngoi kue.

Tongana mo kete gï mot oko na ngbâ na forme ti ordre tongana ni ayeke (d), ni abâ ti ngbele ngoi kue.
